You can tell customer experience is a complete afterthought and that the whole dev team is probably offshored. Constantly crashing, greying out, etc. 

The hotels themselves are fine - you get what you pay for.

reviews.title: Web experience
reviews.text: Joining program and making a reservation has been like dial up experience. Every interaction was a 20 to 30 second wait. It would log me out, did not save info. Have not had a sign up experience this bad in a decade.

reviews.title: Slow go
reviews.text: Took forever to book

reviews.title: Did not hold Reservation
reviews.text: I had approximately 2 minutes to enter my credit card and by the time I did the site said the room was no longer available and the next room available was an additional $100. This is absolutely unacceptable. Any reputable app or website gives you a countdown as to how long you have to book this reservation. That is not the case with World of Hyatt and if I had longer to book a room than for this week I would stay elsewhere. I will NEVER stay at a hyatt ever again.

reviews.title: Not user friendly

reviews.title: Horrible App - Always Sluggish or Worse
reviews.text: By far, the worst hotel app I suffer the use of. Digital keys more often than not do not work at many properties and the app is often extremely slow to confirm a reservation (best case) or crashes and asks me to try back later. Also, impossible to save all credit card information in the app. I often have to re-enter card number, expiration date or security code —and any combination thereof — even though I recently entered them.

reviews.title: Payment usability fail
reviews.text: Why on earth can't I use the credit card information that is stored on my iphone? It's a standard business process. No digital wallet access either. But trying to access bluetooth to snoop on devices. Just awful.

They expire your points / rewards after 2 years and that’s insane in this day and age. F that. 

They followed up on this comment and doubled down on their stance. How embarrassing.

reviews.title: Functional but needs better UX

reviews.title: Makes you review

reviews.title: Needs update and password sign in every time I use the app
reviews.text: I only travel about once a month and typically prefer Hyatt hotels when it makes sense.  This app wants an update, sign in, security code every time.  Not very convenient

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: Their own credit card doesn’t work. Reward nights cannot be booked. Quality going downhill and greed going up and up

reviews.title: Managing your world of Hyatt account on this app is BAD
reviews.text: This app will not even let you log in to your account to manage.  I can log into the web interface on a browser no problem.  Terrible app.

reviews.title: Locks me out
reviews.text: Poor app.  Signed up but in trying to validate me, it has now locked me out and asked me to call a number in the US - I’m in London. So much for a global brand

reviews.title: Worst hotel to book through
reviews.text:
I tried booking a room through Hyatt, I called confirmed multiple rooms were available (atleast 3). The Hyatt representative told me they can’t guarantee sales but if I call back in 30 minutes I’ll be able to get one cause they aren’t selling that quickly. I called back less than 20 minutes later and they were all sold out. 
I try calling the front desk like every other hotel but it sends me to their corporate phone every time. 
Hyatt makes things too corporate, not a personal or pleasureful experience to deal with them

reviews.title: My time is valuable
reviews.text: 3 attempts and an hour to make a reservation because 4 rooms are needed and the app allows a mx if 2.  Called and had a foreign person mistakenly not changing my billing address.  After 30 minutes I gave up on him.  Next, let’s try the chat.  Another foreign person but at least chat is typed so there was no issue with the language.  Still 30 minutes  went by and when we got to the payment to update, I had to go back to the app and it disconnected us.  Hey Hyatt, how much business are you losing by going cheap with client interaction?  You are definitely my third choice and will stay that way if this continues to be your operating model.

reviews.title: Charlotte Arrowood Hyatt
reviews.text: I have been a loyal Hyatt member for years now. I was not made aware that today’s stay had no elevator service. Also, there was a complete hotel renovation going on as well. I could not check in prior to 3pm as was offered on the app. I was also told that they couldn’t tell me what floor that I would be on and I would have to wait to find out. Therefore have to use the stairs with luggage. I am extremely disappointed in this experience. I had to book elsewhere due to this. I will look for another brand to do business with in the future.

reviews.title: No GBP
reviews.text: For some reason,  you can’t have hotels display pricing in Great British Pounds. Many, many other currencies, but not GBP. Very annoying and strange

reviews.title: Unprofessional website & App
reviews.text:
I’ve never experienced such an unprofessional website & app for a hotel. Between both it’s quite impossible to use functions as intended. If I’m trying to book a specific
Hotel and view rooms, that should be a feature that actually works. If I’m trying to link my American Airlines account, that feature should also work. Using a hotel website should not be this hard. I do not have this issue with competitor hotels! If I can’t even use the Hyatt website seamlessly how do I know my information is safe with this hotel!

reviews.title: Worst customer experience ever
reviews.text: I had a stay booked with my award points that did not go through due to a system error and the specialist did not even read what I was suggesting. I was treated like S… after having been a loyal customer for years!!!

reviews.title: App not working without update - won’t update either
reviews.text: When I open the app, I’m blocked with an “Update Required” screen. However, the update requires iOS 18. As my device is on iOS 17 this means the app is dead for me. This is a reflection of poor technology strategy from Hyatt. No loyal customers should be left behind.

reviews.title: Version 26.2.0 completely broke voiceover for iOS accessibility and no Hyatt accessibility statement
reviews.text: This most recent version completely broke iOS, voiceover accessibility, which is critical for users who are Blind who use the VoiceOver screen reader on iOS devices. The update essentially made the app a brick and completely useless. Voiceover does not read any information in the tabs any longer and you cannot interact with or access key information about your account or reservations. Also, I’m a Hyatt website. There is no accessibility statement and no way to contact a specific team handling accessibility. They tell you to contact the standard customer service channels, and those people are gonna have no idea what we’re talking about when we’re speaking of iOS voiceover accessibility, and the related information that a developer would need to address that.
